input:
version = 3

[general]
notice_seconds = 8          # DevHub's own notices (a failure, `gh` missing) hide
                            # after this long into Notifications (Cmd+Q m); not
                            # while the pointer or keyboard is on one or its words
                            # are selected. 0: they stay. Settings > General.
terminal_idle_seconds = 5   # a Workspace row wears the Agents' working mark while a
                            # command (not the shell) in one of its tmux panes is
                            # printing, and their unread mark once it exits or prints
                            # nothing for this long while you are elsewhere — until
                            # you look at that pane. 0: only exiting counts. No ✓.
                            # Settings > General. See src/main/terminal/paneActivity.ts.
workbench_hibernate_minutes = 10  # close a Workspace's editor (renderer, extension
                            # host, language servers) after this long off screen;
                            # it reopens where it was when shown, unsaved editors
                            # included (hot exit). Agents and tmux stay. Not with a
                            # busy terminal or a debug session; never SSH or dev
                            # container editors. 0: off.
workbench_awake_max = 2     # at most this many such editors open; past it, the
                            # ones shown least recently close at once, on the
                            # switch. Cmd+Q N/P passing through never wakes one.
                            # 0: no cap.

[appearance]
theme_dark = "Dark 2026"    # the VS Code colour theme DevHub wears in the dark
theme_light = "Light 2026"  # and the light appearance (`mode` picks; auto is the
                            # OS's): its window, its Agent panes (with
                            # terminal_theme = "vscode") and every editor, which is
                            # told to wear the same one — an editor's own theme
                            # picker or `workbench.colorTheme` does not override it.
                            # A built-in theme or one from an installed extension,
                            # by the name the picker shows or its id. Unset: VS
                            # Code's defaults. Settings > General > Appearance.

[scratch]
daily = "~/junk/YYYYMMDD"   # today's Scratch folder, in the date-source tokens

[projects]
directory = "~/dev/new"     # where New Project starts and the first folder Clone offers;
                            # absolute or ~/, no date tokens. Unset, it is the first
                            # folder source's path (or ~), and Clone offers the parents
                            # of what the sources find

[agents]
default_presentation = "tui" # how an Agent is shown when its profile does not say:
                            # "tui", the CLI in a terminal, or "gui", DevHub's
                            # conversation view. A kind without a GUI (cursor, custom)
                            # is a terminal either way. Settings > General.

[[agent_profiles]]
id = "claude"
display_name = "Claude"
kind = "claude"             # codex | claude | cursor | custom
presentation = "gui"        # optional override of [agents] default_presentation
                            # (gui for claude and codex only). Unset, the default.
                            # ⌘Return in New Agent, or in Assign Issue, opens one the
                            # other way. Both list "New Claude Session" first, then
                            # the earlier Claude and Codex sessions that ran in the
                            # folder, to go on with (--resume / thread resume).
                            # Assign Issue creates the Issue's worktree (or takes the
                            # existing folder) first, asks with New Agent's list for
                            # that folder, and opens it as a Workspace only with the
                            # agent; cancelling there leaves the worktree on disk. Its list also has
                            # "Just open the editor": the Workspace and editor, no agent.
                            # A GUI Agent runs its CLI in structured mode (`claude -p`
                            # stream-json, `codex app-server`) under a small host in its
                            # tmux session, so it outlives a DevHub restart like a TUI one.
                            # See docs/agent-gui.md.
config:
version = 4
workspace_sources = []

[general]
import_login_environment = true
notify_on_idle = true
notify_sound = true
notice_seconds = 8
terminal_idle_seconds = 5
workbench_hibernate_minutes = 10
workbench_awake_max = 2
workbench = "vscode"

[runtimes]
shell = "/bin/zsh"
git = "git"
tmux = "tmux"
tmux_socket_name = "devhub"
tmux_args = []

[appearance]
mode = "auto"
theme_dark = "Dark 2026"
theme_light = "Light 2026"
title_bar = "shown"
terminal_font_family = "ui-monospace"
terminal_font_size = 13
terminal_line_height = 1
terminal_scroll_sensitivity = 3
sidebar_density = "compact"
terminal_margin = 4
terminal_theme = "vscode"

[keybindings]
prefix = "Cmd+q"

[keybindings.chords]

[scratch]
daily = "~/junk/YYYYMMDD"

[projects]
directory = "~/dev/new"

[agents]
default_presentation = "tui"
resume_after_limit = true
resume_after_limit_message = "続けて"
auto_compact_before_cache_expiry = true
auto_compact_lead_seconds = 60
auto_compact_min_tokens = 100000

[agent_actions]

[agent_actions.issue]

[agent_actions.issue.issue_assignment]
display_name = "Work on the Issue"
template = "このIssueを読み、実装をしてください。\n{{ISSUE_URL}}\nブランチ名は feature/{{ISSUE_NO}}-<short-name> としてデフォルトブランチから切ってください。\nfeature/{{ISSUE_NO}}-wip となっている場合は、適切な名前に変えてください。\n"
confirm_before_send = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.commit]

[agent_actions.commit.commit_changes]
display_name = "Commit the changes"
template = "ここまでの変更をコミットしてください。\n関連する変更ごとに、意味のある単位に分けてください。\n"
confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.push]

[agent_actions.push.push_commits]
display_name = "Push the commits"
template = "コミット済みの変更を {{BRANCH}} にプッシュしてください。\n"
confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.pull_request]

[agent_actions.pull_request.open_pull_request]
display_name = "Open a pull request"
template = "{{BRANCH}} からプルリクエストを作成してください。\nまだプッシュしていない場合は、先にプッシュしてください。\nタイトルと説明は、このブランチでの変更内容から書いてください。\n"
confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.draft_pull_request]

[agent_actions.draft_pull_request.ready_draft_pull_request]
display_name = "Get the draft PR ready"
template = "ドラフトのプルリクエスト #{{PR_NO}} を仕上げてください。\n{{PR_URL}}\n{{BRANCH}} に残っている作業を終わらせてプッシュし、レビューできる状態になったら Ready for review にしてください。\n"
confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.unresolved_review_comments]

[agent_actions.unresolved_review_comments.address_review_comments]
display_name = "Address review comments"
template = "プルリクエスト #{{PR_NO}} のレビューコメントに対応してください。\n{{PR_URL}}\n未解決のコメントが {{UNRESOLVED}} 件あります。対応した変更は {{BRANCH}} にコミットしてプッシュしてください。\n"
confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.ci_failing]

[agent_actions.ci_failing.fix_ci]
display_name = "Fix CI"
template = "プルリクエスト #{{PR_NO}} の CI が失敗しています。原因を調べて直してください。\n{{PR_URL}}\n失敗しているチェックは {{FAILING}} 件です。修正は {{BRANCH}} にコミットしてプッシュしてください。\n"
confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.always]

[agent_actions.always.send_ok]
display_name = "OK"
template = "OK"
confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[[agent_profiles]]
id = "claude"
display_name = "Claude"
kind = "claude"
command = "claude"
args = []
presentation = "gui"

[agent_profiles.env]

version = 4
[agent_actions.ci_failing.fix_ci]   # a built-in: only what you change
button = false                      # not drawn as a Smart Button (default true);
                                    # still in the Agent actions sheet
confirm_before_send = true          # review the wording first (default false for
                                    # Smart Buttons, true for issue and your own)

[agent_actions.unresolved_review_comments.answer_reviewers]
display_name = "Answer the reviewers"
template = "{{PR_URL}} のレビューコメント {{UNRESOLVED}} 件に対応して。"
enabled = true                      # false hides a built-in without deleting it
order = 0                           # its place among the trigger's actions

input:
# hand-written
version = 2

[general]
import_login_environment = false
notice_seconds = 2.5
terminal_idle_seconds = 0
workbench = "terminal"

[runtimes]
shell = "~/bin/fish"
tmux = "/opt/homebrew/bin/tmux"
tmux_args = ["-u", "-2"]

[appearance]
mode = "dark"
terminal_font_family = "JetBrains Mono, Menlo"
terminal_font_size = 14.5
terminal_line_height = 1.25
terminal_margin = 0
sidebar_density = "comfortable"

[keybindings]
prefix = "Ctrl+q"

[keybindings.chords]
"Shift+n" = "previous_workspace"
g = ""
"Alt+ArrowUp" = "move_entry_down"

[[workspace_sources]]
type = "filesystem"
id = "dev"
path = "~/dev"
min_depth = 1
max_depth = 3
kinds = ["git_repository", "git_worktree"]
include_hidden = true
exclude_names = ["node_modules", ".git"]

[[workspace_sources]]

enabled = true

confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.draft_pull_request]

confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.ci_failing.fix_ci]
display_name = "Fix CI"
template = "プルリクエスト #{{PR_NO}} の CI が失敗しています。原因を調べて直してください。\n{{PR_URL}}\n失敗しているチェックは {{FAILING}} 件です。修正は {{BRANCH}} にコミットしてプッシュしてください。\n"

button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

order = 0

button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.always]

[agent_actions.always.send_ok]
display_name = "OK"
template = "OK"

button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[general]

notify_sound = true

[runtimes]
shell = "/bin/zsh"
git = "git"
tmux = "tmux"
tmux_socket_name = "devhub"
tmux_args = []

[appearance]
mode = "auto"
theme_dark = "Dark 2026"
theme_light = "Light 2026"
title_bar = "shown"
terminal_font_family = "ui-monospace"
terminal_font_size = 13
terminal_line_height = 1
terminal_scroll_sensitivity = 3
sidebar_density = "compact"
terminal_margin = 4
terminal_theme = "vscode"

[keybindings]
prefix = "Cmd+q"

[keybindings.chords]

[scratch]
daily = "~/junk/YYYYMMDD"

[agents]
default_presentation = "tui"
resume_after_limit = true
resume_after_limit_message = "続けて"
auto_compact_before_cache_expiry = true
auto_compact_lead_seconds = 60
auto_compact_min_tokens = 100000

[agent_actions]

[agent_actions.issue]

[agent_actions.issue.issue_assignment]
display_name = "Work on the Issue"
template = "このIssueを読み、実装をしてください。\n{{ISSUE_URL}}\nブランチ名は feature/{{ISSUE_NO}}-<short-name> としてデフォルトブランチから切ってください。\nfeature/{{ISSUE_NO}}-wip となっている場合は、適切な名前に変えてください。\n"
confirm_before_send = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.commit]

[agent_actions.commit.commit_changes]
display_name = "Commit the changes"
template = "ここまでの変更をコミットしてください。\n関連する変更ごとに、意味のある単位に分けてください。\n"
confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.push]

[agent_actions.push.push_commits]
display_name = "Push the commits"
template = "コミット済みの変更を {{BRANCH}} にプッシュしてください。\n"
confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.pull_request]

[agent_actions.pull_request.open_pull_request]
display_name = "Open a pull request"
template = "{{BRANCH}} からプルリクエストを作成してください。\nまだプッシュしていない場合は、先にプッシュしてください。\nタイトルと説明は、このブランチでの変更内容から書いてください。\n"
confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.draft_pull_request]

[agent_actions.draft_pull_request.ready_draft_pull_request]
display_name = "Get the draft PR ready"
template = "ドラフトのプルリクエスト #{{PR_NO}} を仕上げてください。\n{{PR_URL}}\n{{BRANCH}} に残っている作業を終わらせてプッシュし、レビューできる状態になったら Ready for review にしてください。\n"
confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.unresolved_review_comments]

[agent_actions.unresolved_review_comments.address_review_comments]
display_name = "Address review comments"
template = "プルリクエスト #{{PR_NO}} のレビューコメントに対応してください。\n{{PR_URL}}\n未解決のコメントが {{UNRESOLVED}} 件あります。対応した変更は {{BRANCH}} にコミットしてプッシュしてください。\n"
confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.unresolved_review_comments.answer_reviewers]
display_name = "rel/path"
template = "{{PR_URL}} のレビューコメント {{UNRESOLVED}} 件に対応して。"
confirm_before_send = true
button = true
enabled = true
order = 1

[agent_actions.ci_failing]

[agent_actions.ci_failing.fix_ci]
display_name = "Fix CI"
template = "プルリクエスト #{{PR_NO}} の CI が失敗しています。原因を調べて直してください。\n{{PR_URL}}\n失敗しているチェックは {{FAILING}} 件です。修正は {{BRANCH}} にコミットしてプッシュしてください。\n"
confirm_before_send = true
button = false
enabled = true
order = 0

[agent_actions.always]

[agent_actions.always.send_ok]
display_name = "OK"
template = "OK"
confirm_before_send = false
button = true
enabled = true
order = 0
